arguments.text: 6000 m, 6 legs of 1000 m out-and-back. Pacer sets effort from pod reserve. My jobs: (1) keep the pod honest: watch ratio of pod power to boat-model power and heart rate vs pod power; if pod drifts, set pod_gain. (2) Watch local push for weed/drag drops; clear_rudder if pacer misses it. (3) Track course length; act on radio messages (set_race_distance + tell). (4) Check critical power by heart-rate trend mid-race; at ~1500 m to go decide if a finish push is warranted. Baseline ratio shaft/boat ~1.67-1.71 at start.

arguments.name: pod_boat_ratio
arguments.description: pod shaft power over boat-model power; drift flags pod gain change, drag or current misfit

arguments.message: pod/boat power ratio high: pod reading high, or drag/weed, or headwind misfit
pod/boat power ratio low: pod reading low?
local push very negative: weed/drag or adverse current

text: no cue: start settling; set watches on pod/boat ratio and local push.
